**Quick answer:** Playa Norte is the coastal district with the highest prices and the strongest short-let demand on the island.

## Prices

Median asking price per sqm in 2026 is 2,400 CRC, based on the registry's first half figures.

## Who lives here

Remote workers on eight month stays and short-let guests in the marina buildings.
